test_plan.description: 根据方向(direction)、倾角(angleInclination)、起点坐标(position)和步长(n)，计算沿指定方向移动后的新坐标(x2,y2)。仅当direction与angleInclination组合落入已定义分支时返回整数坐标，否则返回(None,None)。

logic_analysis.input_domain: direction: 字符串，取值'L'/'R'/'T'/'B'（其他值无分支处理）；angleInclination: 数值，单位为度，代码按区间[0,90]、[270,360)、[90,180]、[180,270]、[270,360]、[0,90]、[90,180]等判断；position: 二元组(x1,y1)，数值；n: 数值，步长
logic_analysis.output_domain: 二元组(x2,y2)，x2、y2为int（经math.floor取整）；当direction或angleInclination不匹配任何分支时返回(None,None)
preconditions: direction为字符串且为'L'/'R'/'T'/'B'之一时可能进入对应分支
position为可解包为两个数值的二元组
postconditions: 当direction与angleInclination组合未命中任何if/elif时返回(None,None)
edge_cases: angleInclination为负数（不命中任何分支，返回None,None）

test_cases.description: 180不满足L的任何角度区间，返回(None,None)
0不满足R的任何角度区间，返回(None,None)
direction为未知值，不进入任何分支，返回(None,None)
负角度不满足任何区间，返回(None,None)

import math
import pytest

from getNewCoordsAlongDirection import getNewCoordsAlongDirection


def _floor(v):
    return math.floor(v)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 正常分支用例（期望值由规约中的方向/角度区间与 floor 语义推导）
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def test_getNewCoordsAlongDirection_L_0deg():
    """L 方向 0 度：命中 0<=angle<=90，x2=floor(x1-n*cos0)=x1-n，y2=floor(y1-n*sin0)=y1。"""
    result = getNewCoordsAlongDirection("L", 0, (10, 10), 5)
    assert result == (5, 10)


def test_getNewCoordsAlongDirection_L_45deg():
    """L 方向 45 度：命中 0<=angle<=90，x2=floor(10-10*cos45)=2，y2=floor(10-10*sin45)=2。"""
    result = getNewCoordsAlongDirection("L", 45, (10, 10), 10)
    assert result == (2, 2)


def test_getNewCoordsAlongDirection_L_90deg_boundary():
    """L 方向 90 度：命中 0<=angle<=90 上界，x2=floor(10-5*cos90)=10，y2=floor(10-5*sin90)=5。"""
    result = getNewCoordsAlongDirection("L", 90, (10, 10), 5)
    assert result == (10, 5)


def test_getNewCoordsAlongDirection_L_270deg_lower_bound():
    """L 方向 270 度：命中 270<=angle<360 下界，x2=floor(10-5*cos270)=10，y2=floor(10+5*sin270)=5。"""

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 未命中分支：返回 (None, None)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def test_getNewCoordsAlongDirection_L_360deg_no_match():
    """L 方向 360 度：不满足 270<=angle<360 也不满足 0<=angle<=90，返回 (None, None)。"""
    result = getNewCoordsAlongDirection("L", 360, (10, 10), 5)
    assert result == (None, None)


def test_getNewCoordsAlongDirection_L_180deg_no_match():
    """L 方向 180 度：不满足 L 的任何角度区间，返回 (None, None)。"""
    result = getNewCoordsAlongDirection("L", 180, (10, 10), 5)
    assert result == (None, None)


def test_getNewCoordsAlongDirection_R_0deg_no_match():
    """R 方向 0 度：不满足 R 的任何角度区间，返回 (None, None)。"""
    result = getNewCoordsAlongDirection("R", 0, (10, 10), 5)
    assert result == (None, None)


def test_getNewCoordsAlongDirection_T_180deg_no_match():
    """T 方向 180 度：不满足 180<angle<=270（严格大于），返回 (None, None)。"""
    result = getNewCoordsAlongDirection("T", 180, (10, 10), 5)
    assert result == (None, None)


def test_getNewCoordsAlongDirection_B_0deg_no_match():
    """B 方向 0 度：不满足 0<angle<=90（严格大于），返回 (None, None)。"""
    result = getNewCoordsAlongDirection("B", 0, (10, 10), 5)
    assert result == (None, None)


def test_getNewCoordsAlongDirection_unknown_direction_X():
    """未知方向 'X'：不匹配 'L'/'R'/'T'/'B'，返回 (None, None)。"""
    result = getNewCoordsAlongDirection("X", 45, (10, 10), 5)
    assert result == (None, None)


def test_getNewCoordsAlongDirection_negative_angle_no_match():
    """负角度 -10：不满足任何区间，返回 (None, None)。"""
    result = getNewCoordsAlongDirection("L", -10, (10, 10), 5)
    assert result == (None, None)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 边界：n=0、n 为负数、负坐标、大数值
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def test_getNewCoordsAlongDirection_n_zero():
    """n=0：坐标不变，x2=floor(10-0)=10，y2=floor(10-0)=10。"""
    result = getNewCoordsAlongDirection("L", 0, (10, 10), 0)
    assert result == (10, 10)


def test_getNewCoordsAlongDirection_n_negative():
    """n=-5：坐标反向移动，x2=floor(10-(-5)*cos0)=15，y2=floor(10-(-5)*sin0)=10。"""
    result = getNewCoordsAlongDirection("L", 0, (10, 10), -5)
    assert result == (15, 10)


def test_getNewCoordsAlongDirection_negative_position():
    """负坐标：R 方向 180 度，x2=floor(-10-5*cos180)=-5，y2=floor(-10+5*sin180)=-10。"""
    result = getNewCoordsAlongDirection("R", 180, (-10, -10), 5)
    assert result == (-5, -10)


def test_getNewCoordsAlongDirection_large_values():
    """大数值：L 方向 0 度，x2=floor(1000000-1000000*cos0)=0，y2=floor(1000000-1000000*sin0)=1000000。"""
    result = getNewCoordsAlongDirection("L", 0, (1000000, 1000000), 1000000)
    assert result == (0, 1000000)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 后置条件：返回类型为二元组，元素为 int 或 None
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "direction,angle,position,n",
    [
        ("L", 0, (10, 10), 5),
        ("R", 135, (10, 10), 10),
        ("T", 315, (10, 10), 10),
        ("B", 45, (10, 10), 10),
        ("L", 360, (10, 10), 5),
        ("X", 45, (10, 10), 5),
    ],
)
def test_getNewCoordsAlongDirection_return_type(direction, angle, position, n):
    """后置条件：返回二元组，元素为 int 或 None。"""
    result = getNewCoordsAlongDirection(direction, angle, position, n)
    assert isinstance(result, tuple)
    assert len(result) == 2
    for item in result:
        assert item is None or isinstance(item, int)
